purpose: Separate easy context mismatch learning from adversarial unanswerability without changing the attention-only reader.

b1_cross_pair_500.handwritten: 3/5 answerable probes exact; neutral unsupported password was answered as 'hilltop' with p_answerable=0.96484375.

b2_official_only_500.data: 81% N2 answerable, 19% official SQuAD2 unanswerable; starts from B1
b2_official_only_500.finding: Sequential adversarial fine-tuning catastrophically forgot B1's useful answer/refusal separation.

b3_mixed_replay_500.data: 70% N2 answerable, 15% cross-pair, 15% official SQuAD2 unanswerable; starts from B1
b3_mixed_replay_500.finding: Replay prevents total collapse but does not recover useful strict-threshold coverage on adversarial negatives.

decision: Stop this distribution family at 500 steps. Next add and evaluate an explicit entity-binding negative stage between cross-pair and official SQuAD2 negatives; do not extend B2 or B3 unchanged.
